facts.summary: FDA issued complete response letter citing insufficient efficacy evidence · Filed (NDA) · reproxalap in dry eye disease · filed for approval

evidence.summary: The Complete Response Letter stated that the NDA “failed to demonstrate efficacy in adequate and well controlled studies in treating ocular symptoms associated with dry eyes”
evidence.safety: No manufacturing or safety issues were identified in the letter.
evidence.program_discontinued: Contingent on positive results and FDA discussions, NDA resubmission is anticipated mid-2025.
